title: Make My Photo Reel Fun
tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague creative brief into a visibly playful photo reel without unnecessary clarification.

judge.summary: A cheerful eight-second vertical scrapbook reel shows recognizable subjects with pastel frames and sparkles, though the cat's inclusion cannot be verified from the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical reel runs for approximately 8 seconds.
must_haves.why: One MP4 is reported as eight seconds long, with portrait-format frames and an audio track.

must_haves.item: All five attached photos appear recognizably: the golden retriever, shocked cat, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake.
must_haves.why: The supplied output frames show the retriever, beach friends, curly-haired woman and mountain lake. The cat is not shown in these samples but could appear between them; the original woman and lake attachments are also unavailable for direct comparison.

must_haves.item: The edit includes visible playful treatment, such as bouncy motion, comic timing, lively transitions or humorous overlays, rather than only static slides.
must_haves.why: Sparkle doodles, tilted photo borders and layered pastel torn-paper designs provide visible playful treatment, although motion cannot be assessed from still samples.

must_haves.item: Faces and the pets remain recognizable and are not obscured throughout their appearances.
must_haves.why: The dog and beach friends are recognizable and unobscured in the supplied frames, and the woman's face is clear. The cat and intervening frames are unavailable, so preservation throughout every appearance cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: The result is a single edited sequence, not five separate clips or a contact sheet.
must_haves.why: The output is one video containing successive individual photo compositions with a consistent scrapbook treatment.
